description: Deterministically audit ISO 20022 pacs.008/pain.001 wire transfers, ACH batches, counterparty allowlists, Dual-Control thresholds, and exact BigRat L*/C*/n* pilot ROI in integer microDollars before release. Trigger on wire transfer release, ISO 20022 payment screening, ACH velocity cap, treasury Dual-Control, or breakeven L* pilot economics.

amountMicroDollars.description: Exact wire or ACH transfer amount in integer microDollars (1 USD = 1_000_000). [Zero-Float Unit: microDollars (Int64)]

counterpartyID.description: Counterparty BIC/IBAN or verified treasury identifier. [Zero-Float Unit: UTF-8 identifier]

dailyVelocityMicroDollars.description: Cumulative 24-hour outflow in integer microDollars. [Zero-Float Unit: microDollars (Int64)]

dualControlApproved.description: Whether second-signer Dual-Control cryptographic approval is attached. [Zero-Float Unit: Boolean]

name: affine_payment_prerelease_audit
